verdict.rationale: Llama ships open, gated weights via Meta/Hugging Face plus an official CLI for downloading and verifying models, and multiple first-party runtimes such as llama.cpp and ExecuTorch enable self-hosting on desktop, mobile, and edge devices. However, self-hosting requires accepting a non-OSI Community License with an approval process, and the developer docs are gated behind an SSO wall, undercutting a frictionless self-host story. missing for 10: fully open-source licensing without gated approval, publicly accessible self-host documentation without SSO login
